6 Myths About Red Light Laser Hair Caps

Hair loss among men and women is an extremely common occurrence. With this being said, it is no doubt that individuals like you are looking for ways to combat your hair loss once and for all. You may have heard of laser caps and red light therapy for hair growth. These FDA-cleared devices (red light therapy caps for hair loss) have been clinically proven to help grow hair thicker and fuller on the scalp. So, what’s stopping you?

Are you interested in purchasing a laser cap or trying red light therapy for hair growth, but need a few questions answered first?

There are several red light therapy cap myths out there floating around. One of these myths might be the one in the back of your mind stopping you from purchasing. Well, keep reading below for the 6 myths of laser hair caps to see if these are ones that you currently are skeptical about.

1.) Red Light Therapy for Hair Growth is Harmful to the Brain:

Low level light therapy (LLLT) using a red light cap for hair growth cap is proven to be safe and effective for human use. For your assurance, Kiierr laser caps are FDA-cleared for safety and effectiveness in both men and women. This light therapy has been proven to achieve positive improvement with depression, Alzheimer’s and more. According to Dr. Greg Hipskind, founder of Functional Brain Imaging, Inc., “light therapy improves cognitive brain function and cerebral blood flow after traumatic brain injury.”

Additionally, a double blind study conducted in 2018 states that patients who underwent LLLT for traumatic brain injuries (TBI) demonstrated an increase in cognitive function with improvements to their memory and attention abilities in addition to an increase in mood performance. The irony of this myth is that red light therapy is actually used to treat brain injuries and has proven to improve symptoms.

Therefore, this myth is far from the truth. Medical professionals and scientists all around the world are turning patients towards red light therapy for hair growth to safely and naturally stimulate the hair follicles on the scalp.

2.) Kiierr Red light Laser Hair Cap ONLY Works for Men:

One of the most common myths about red light laser caps is that they are only successfully used by men treating male pattern baldness and other forms of hair loss. This is far from the truth. Laser caps are designed to be used by BOTH men and women looking to improve the health, strength, and thickness of their hair.  In fact, some of the best hair growth results we have seen stem from women using the cap to improve their postpartum hair loss after pregnancy.

In 2018 a clinical study was conducted on the effectiveness of red light therapy in women ages 18-60.  This study, documented in the National Library of Medicine, shows that women who received red light therapy treatment every other day for a period of seventeen weeks received a 51% increase in their hair count as a result of red light therapy.

If you are a woman looking to achieve hair growth results, a laser cap could be your answer! Do not hesitate to start your hair growth journey with the Kiierr laser hair cap to combat your hair loss condition today!

3.) Red light Laser Caps are too Expensive:

Laser caps can be very affordable especially when compared to expensive clinical treatments costing thousands of dollars. Kiierr laser caps for hair growth are some of the most affordable hair growth devices available for at home use. Kiierr has also partnered with Affirm, providing monthly payment options for customers not wanting to pay in full. You will have the choice to submit payments on your laser cap over 3, 6, or 12 months.

Also, keep in mind that the purchase of your laser cap is a one time purchase. You are not having to pay for each visit to the clinic if you wanted to get this same treatment done at your doctor or dermatologist’s office. Pay for this FDA-cleared medical device and you can enjoy the hair growth results for months and even years down the road!

4.) Red Light Hair Growth Caps (laser caps) Must be Prescribed or Purchased From a Doctor:

Red light hair growth caps were once only available through expensive procedures completed by physicians in clinics. However these days,  this therapy can be completed on your own time, in the comfort of your own home. Although it is always a good idea to speak with your medical professional before you begin any new treatment, it is not required. Anyone looking to improve the health of their hair can purchase a laser cap.

5.) Red Light Therapy for Hair Loss is Painful or Cumbersome to Use:

Red light therapy for hair loss and the Kiierr laser cap is designed for comfortable and hands-free use. This all natural treatment is a pain-free hair growth treatment option available for both men and women looking to improve the health of your hair. The device is completely portable, allowing you to finish your treatment sitting on the couch relaxing, moving around doing household chores, driving, etc. Customers may experience a warm sensation on the scalp towards the end of treatment due to increased blood flow and circulation to the scalp. However, no pain should be felt throughout the treatment therapy.

6.) Red Light Laser Hair Caps Only Work for People Who are Balding:

Red light therapy hair caps are not directed for hair thinning customers only. Although the most dramatic before/after results photos may be seen from these candidates, you don’t have to suffer from major thinning or hair loss to benefit from a laser cap.

LLLT is a proven technology that strengthens as well as regenerates hair follicles on the scalp. Laser caps are a great option for those who want to be proactive and catch thinning hair before it increases. Many Kiierr customers use our Laser caps to keep a thick head of hair and avoid thinning/balding altogether.

 

Red Light Therapy Cap For Hair Loss Conclusion

These 6 myths of laser hair caps and LLLT treatment are busted! Don’t let false information deter you from growing your hair. This technology has provided you with the easiest way to improve your hair health. If there are any other questions you may have about red light hair growth therapy and laser hair caps, leave them in the comments below.

Get ahead of your hair loss today with the Kiierr laser cap and let us help you get your hair back to its healthiest stage. Get started on your hair growth journey today!

 

Do you have anymore unanswered questions for us? Leave them in the comments below! If not, checkout our next article: Do laser caps work?
